summary: 23 hikers and three dogs trapped on Ice Lakes-area trails when the Ice Fire ignited near the trailhead around 1 p.m.; evacuated by helicopter after the fire reached ~320 acres by 9 p.m.
location: Ice Lakes Trailhead area, west of Silverton
responding_agency: San Juan County Sheriff; San Juan National Forest
notes: Wildfire evacuation assist; Forest Service assisted San Juan County in the evacuation; South Mineral Road and campground evacuated.
